observations: A skeletal figure hangs upside-down across the center, its ribcage and limb bones rendered in dark outline over olive and amber fill, against a saturated red field.
Seven thick horizontal bands of deep red-brown stripe the background, each edged with a thin white line, creating a layered, slatted pattern behind the figure.
The lower head is the most color-saturated zone — yellow, orange, and black marks cluster around open eye sockets and bared teeth, contrasting with the muted bone tones above.
reading: An inverted skeletal form descends through horizontal bands that read as both shadow and barrier. The bones are loosely drawn, with gaps between outline and fill that give the structure a see-through quality. The head at the bottom carries the most heat — yellow and orange flare around hollow eyes — while the upper limbs fade into cooler olive. The image reads as suspended, neither falling nor resting.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #24 and nnxyz nnotb #26 share the red field but differ sharply: #24 fills the frame with a close face on grey, and #26 renders a dark figure on near-black. This work sits between those two color extremes.

connections.reason: Both works use a saturated red ground and white outline lines as structural elements, but #24 places its subject upright and close, while #25 inverts and distances the figure through horizontal banding.
